question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Take away your breath
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Astonishing'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**take away your breath**" is used to describe something extremely beautiful or surprising that it makes you gasp in amazement (इसका उपयोग किसी अत्यंत सुंदर या आश्चर्यजनक चीज़ का वर्णन करने के लिए किया जाता है). .

 
 
• **Example**: "*The view of the starry night sky from the top of the hill can really** take away your breath.*****"**
 
 
 
• It is used to describe a situation where you find something so impressive or shocking that it leaves you speechless.
 
• Based on the given points, the correct meaning is **'astonishing'. **

Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 1. **
